newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares spurred higher by results, Dow Jones.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares spurred higher by results, Dow Jones.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange closed firmer Tuesday on the back of favourable first quarter company results and a bullish Wall Street.
Peruvian stocks listed in New York benefited from Wall Street's rally, but some investors were nervously awaiting further company results due on Wednesday, the brokers added.
"We're still expecting the important company results, so many investors prefer to wait," said broker Jorge Gutierrez at Coril brokerage.

The blue-chip index closed up 0.06 percent at 2,550.05 points, with a volume of 40.4 million soles of shares traded ($15 million), according to preliminary figures, while the general index rose 0.41 percent to 1,752.62.
Volumes were driven higher by investor interest in blue- chip leader Telefonica de Peru and holding company Credicorp.

Credicorp was up 1.78 percent at $21.30 dollars with 131, 801 shares traded, while mining group Buenaventura was up 1.36 percent at 22.30 soles on the back of company results in line with market expectations.
Telefonica de Peru closed up 1.11 percent at 6.40 soles.
Shares in mining company Morococha fell back 4.07 percent to 2.59 soles with 269.094 shares traded.
Brokers said several stocks in the mining sector were overvalued and could come under pressure in coming days.
